newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi shares close marginally high in mixed trade.
newsitem.headline: Delhi shares close marginally high in mixed trade.

text.p: Share prices on the Delhi Stock Exchange closed virtually unchanged in mixed trade as profit selling by speculators squared off gains made on buying by financial institutions, brokers said.
The bourse's benchmark index closed 0.08 points higher at 701.05.
"There is no worthwhile support to the capital market and shares moved bothways on small bouts of buying and selling," said Mani Kumar of brokers Share Tips Investment.
Bajaj Auto was the major benefector, the share gained 18 rupees to 948, brokers said.
Asian Hotels rose 1.75 rupees to 243 while DCM Shriram firmed 3.60 rupees to 87.
Reliance Industries lost 3.55 rupees to close at 190.20.
State Bank of India lost 2.65 rupees to 210.20, while Oriental Bank of Commerce was down 1.95 rupees to 62.50 on profit taking, brokers said.
Larsen and Toubro shed 3.80 rupees at 211.
ITC was down 15.90 rupees, or 4.78 percent, to 316.25 on heavy selling by speculators, brokers said.
